newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar closes unchanged in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar closes unchanged in dull trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar finished flat after another lacklustre session as the U.S. dollar bumped against resistance at 112 yen in Asian markets.
At the close, the Taiwan dollar was quoted at T$27.49, unchanged from Wednesday's close. Turnover improved to US$199 million from US$169.5 million.
"The Taiwan dollar did not move at all," said a foreign bank dealer. "It bobbed up and down in the same place."
With the U.S. dollar stymied at 112 yen and ahead of the September U.S. non-farm payrolls report, the market had no direction, she said.
Economists surveyed by Reuters said they expected fewer new U.S. jobs to have been created in September, which could weaken the U.S. dollar.
The monthly U.S. employment report for September was scheduled for release late on Friday Taiwan time.
